correctness.rationale: Adjacent square obstruction gives column-cycle cover. Contract each undeleted rung: no adjacent full columns, at most one horizontal edge per consecutive column pair. The resulting graph is a cycle punctured by either double-deleted columns or opposite-rail singleton pairs, preserving cycles and components. Odd and even vertex-cover cases exhaust cardinality-optimal configurations. Binomial cyclic-gap count and two independent edge-parity constraints yield exact counts; standalone disjoint-set replay checks 656077 candidates, n=3..12. General validity follows from the proof, not finite tests.
